passages.text: Pay by card when you book the welcome session. Keep the confirmation email until the event is over.

passages.title: Message for participants
passages.text: Plans changed? You can move your booking free of charge until Wednesday. If you arrive late, please wait at the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

writing.prompt: Write a short message to a new international friend. Introduce yourself and ask two questions.

practice.prompt: 给朋友写 2–3 句关于「Weekly Challenge: Meet a New Friend」的英语消息，使用 pleased 并补充一个具体细节。
写 25–40 词邀请朋友参加 welcome session，写明时间、房间和要带的物品。
写 25–40 词给将要迟到的朋友，根据阅读通知告诉对方到哪里等、向谁求助。
写 35–50 词说明你在「Weekly Challenge: Meet a New Friend」场景中的选择与理由，尽量运用本课语法（第一周综合语法复习）。

quiz.prompt: Choose a friendly greeting when meeting someone.
quiz.explanation: Nice to meet you是初次见面的自然表达。

quiz.prompt: Choose the correct question about someone's job.
quiz.explanation: What do you do?是常用职业询问方式。
